notes.title: Update Notes For Ver. 1.22
notes.content:
-	Increased the texture quality to 4k
-	Optimized general fidelity of graphics and added details to all levels.
-	Added cinematic effects such as realistic depth of field and camera focal length
-	Ship’s movement is more dynamic (yaw rotation is calculated dynamically).
-	Satellites’ active range is lowered (they are more likely to stop intercepting when the player gets out of its range)
-	Gatling Gun’s energy consumption is lowered.

notes.title: Quality of Life Updates 1.1
notes.content:
It has been one hell of a month, full of fun surprises and good news, folks. Having close connections with a legendary programmer and game designer Mev Dinc came as a power-boost for our creativity and game improvements. He kindly reviewed our game and helped us come up with a solid plan for major updates to our well received game. We can’t thank him enough for this. Thank you Mev for the wonderful tinkering process and all of the insightful thoughts😊

So lets jump to the fun part; the first installment of quality-of-life changes. Our players unique thoughts and comments led us to go over the game mechanics, environments, color palettes and performance. In that sense, we are updating our game as well as our workflow which has become part of our learning curve. 

Our first quality of life update is addressing the following issues:

- Flashing Text of Dialogues and Intros: Knowing that certain flashing patterns may cause a photosensitive response in viewers, we have chosen to get rid of that effect for better readability and healthier sight.

- Ship/Environment Contrast: Having an experienced pair of eyes (Mev Dinc) to review our levels led us to increase the contrast between the ship and the environments. Color palette and self-illumination methods are being updated for better viewing experience.

- Frame Rate: Our original approach to frame rate of this game was setting it to 45 fps which proved to be an issue for certain high-end PCs. For that matter, we started improving draw-calls with various methods and aimed at setting the FPS to 60.

- Visual Quality and Performance Improvements: Art evolves itself and so does a game. We are working on getting better results of our 3D art style and pushing ourselves for improving the coding to yield satisfactory performance. 

Thank you all for the journey and see you in our next news.

notes.title: Timewell: Trail Of Celestes is released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585785/71fda20efb6bb30b2eab07aeae03c0fb6ef2f5db.gif[/img]

[h3]After two years of working, sleepless nights and neglected partners, we finally released our first game [b]Timewell: Trail of Celestes[/b]. Cheers, 1000 exp to us all and the chicken ːsteamhappyː[/h3]

[previewyoutube=pYQ0Xtrqp18;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585785/01aeded559b4f7bc2c4b09b91487f3c81699a2c2.png[/img]

[b]Timewell: Trail of Celestes[/b] is the first installment in Timewell Universe where [b]space-shooter[/b] genre meets [b]story-driven[/b] gameplay and light [b]RPG[/b] elements. Player controls a Vulcan class space fighter as the A.I. SAT-V. Having an artificial personality of its own, SAT-V can adapt to varying degrees of difficulties and change its capabilities via skills and adaptations. Use your judgement and skill points to guide SAT-V to her destiny!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585785/2a7a4bc955a6ff4398d1f703d9cd985d683f0e6a.png[/img]


- [b]Timewell Universe[/b]: Trail of Celestes is the first installment in Timewell Universe where space shooter genre meets story driven gameplay and light RPG elements. Can you uncover the truth behind the struggle of supreme beings known as Celestes and their formidable opponents, Constructs?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585785/09a941fa3f3e87d56a3c5bcb946a2df44be393e7.gif[/img]

- [b]Story Mode[/b]: A tale of suspense and deceit takes place in exotic corners of the galaxy. You control a Vulcan class space fighter as the A.I. SAT-V. Can you guide her to her destiny?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585785/3c7faa6d7db4f15a27b4eec43a54682d55cafe4c.gif[/img]

- [b]Skills / Adaptations[/b]: Having an artificial personality of its own, SAT-V can adapt to varying degrees of difficulties and change its capabilities via skills and adaptations. You can change skill points and perks on the fly and enhance your gameplay with different tactics. Can you overcome perils with brain as well as brawn?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585785/601f83b2577a812b8c649f3a99c8a15fd19d8cd4.gif[/img]

- [b]Achievements / Relics[/b]: Fun feats that can be unlocked throughout the game provide Relics as rewards and they are added to your inventory on each play through. These relics are alien artifacts that can boost SAT-V’s stats and skills. Once unlocked via Achievements, Epic and Legendary Relics provide unique boosts to your gaming style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585785/8e4b53b08db2e2a85c2a86e5398f1f7ad29e8492.gif[/img]

- [b]Customize Looks[/b]: You can customize look and feel of your ship with paint modes randomly looted from enemies. When unlocked, they are yours and you can use them on each play through.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585785/319f9b9d288919c000b46e0a7ac7f281fae7be33.gif[/img]

- [b]Skirmish Mode[/b]: For casual players, fast skirmish mode with different world settings is also included. Each zone has a secret mini-boss to encounter. Are you up for the challenge?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585785/91a28323bf66ae3b810b18db8f1a3aa702cea2dc.gif[/img]

- [b]Easter Eggs[/b]: Funny (and somewhat mysterious?!) easter eggs wait for you to be discovered. Can you solve the riddles of The Unfathomable Scholar ? Can you ?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585785/f04098dfd608130cf2f2cdd229716870302cdbc0.gif[/img]

Enjoy and breath in the rich atmosphere of Timewell Universe where SAT-V plays a key role in the survival of three galactic races. May you guide her to her destination through an adventure of deceit and suspense?
